role: The agent-only dev ops (built only with NETHERITE_DEV, into play-dev and test_snapshots): applies one tape-header Dev command at the head of the integrated server tick, mirroring netherite.oracle.Dev: time, weather, gamerule, difficulty, clear, xp, setblock/fill (with destroy drops and spawner, furnace, sign-line and skull tile data), give, summon, hurt (the dragon), hanging, purge, orb, slot, state and tp.
gpu: line 54, function dev_end: malloc of the dev_writes copy
line 245, function dev_set_blocks (setblock tile): malloc of the spawner's mob id string, free of the old one
line 268, 285, function dev_set_blocks (setblock tile): free of furnace slot tags and te->raw
line 87-94, 514-552, functions dev_summon and dev_apply (hanging): a copied det_state swapped in through pointers (the fake-det dance) so constructor draws land on the server streams
line 145-166, function dev_purge: frees and reinitializes whole entity worlds (ie_free, fh_free, an_free, spawner_free)
line 361, 371, function dev_apply: writes the global surv (keep_inventory, difficulty)
line 185-300, function dev_set_blocks (setblock/fill): saves and restores the global blockcb_env
line 408-422, function dev_apply (setblock/fill): swaps the global te_dispenser_random hook and place.c's case det around the writes
function dev_purge: the purged livings and the old player twin go to grave_bury (grave.c's global list; off unless the replay harness enables it)
notes: Not vanilla gameplay: it replaces the vanilla commands (CommandSetBlock, CommandSummon, CommandGive, CommandTime, CommandWeather, CommandGameRule, CommandXP, CommandTeleport) with the oracle's own Dev ops, so tick_path is true only in dev tapes. The product play binary never links it (csrc/Makefile filters src/dev.c out of SRC). Recordings: out/java/snapshots/dev-give-s1, dev-pen-s1, dev-world-s1 and the end-*-s1 tapes (hurt op) use it. The summon kind table lists CaveSpider twice (harmless). The hanging kind check at line 458 uses && where || looks intended, so an unknown kind is not rejected there (it falls to fh_spawn_frame); not verified against Dev.java. setblock and fill spend TileEntityDispenser's constructor seeder draw on the SERVER role (a dispenser or dropper written by the op), with the placement case's OTHER-role draw swapped off around the writes. lane/netherfire: dev_summon registers every summoned mob with a spawn kind in the spawner records (spawner_register_living), so World.countEntities counts a summoned blaze or ghast toward the natural cap and its box blocks a natural spawn (fight-blaze-s42 failed at row 132 without it). lane/idxentity: the summon's "loot" and "breakdoors" keys; a summoned living's air is 0 (the NBT read).
